text: AI excels at drafting messages, rewriting text for clarity, summarizing long documents, explaining difficult concepts, and organizing messy tables.
But it requires care with exact figures, mental calculations, recent events, and anything not shared with it.
AI skill is uneven: success on one task does not guarantee success on another.
Follow the trust rule: check in proportion to the stakes.
For low-stakes brainstorming, a quick read is enough.
For shared internal reports, verify key facts.
For legal, financial, or customer-facing work, conduct a full review with an expert.
Finally, protect privacy: never paste passwords, customer personal data, or confidential company information.
